name: In-LineLinc Relay
description: The dual-band In-LineLinc relay, which runs the KeypadLinc code base with a single load. Its extended Get reply carries LED dimming in D3 and a signal-to-noise value in D9, where the In-LineLinc dimmers carry the LED brightness.

enumerations.name: manualChangeDirection
enumerations.description: Which way a manual change moves the level.

enumerations.name: setButtonTap
enumerations.description: What a remote tap of the set button sets.

values.name: onLevel
values.description: Sets the on-level to the load's level. Turn the load on to that level with cmd1 0x11 first.

enumerations.name: triggerLevel
enumerations.description: Which level a triggered group sets the local load to.

enumerations.name: triggerRampRate
enumerations.description: How fast a triggered group changes the local load.

values.name: localRampRate
values.description: At the local load's ramp rate.

operatingFlags.name: programmingLock
operatingFlags.description: Linking and programming from the device itself are locked out.

operatingFlags.name: ledOnTransmit
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when the device sends an Insteon message.

operatingFlags.name: resumeDim
operatingFlags.description: Turning the load on at the device restores its last level instead of the on-level.

operatingFlags.name: ledOff
operatingFlags.description: The status LEDs and button backlights are off.

verification.note: Insteon's earliest command sheet swaps 0x08 and 0x09 (backlight on and off); the later sheets, used here, agree with the Insteon for Hub app. The Insteon Developer's Guide reads bit 4 of the 0x00 reply as LED on, but the later command sheets read it as LED off, the state 0x08 sets.

operatingFlags.name: keyBeep
operatingFlags.description: The device beeps when a button is pressed.

verification.note: The 2475SDB Developer Notes list bit 5 of the 0x00 reply as load sense, but its Set Operating Flags table makes 0x0A and 0x0B the key beep, as Insteon's command sheets and the Insteon for Hub app do.

operatingFlags.name: radioOff
operatingFlags.description: The device doesn't originate RF messages. It still repeats the RF messages it hears.

operatingFlags.name: powerLineOff
operatingFlags.description: Insteon communication over the power line is off. The device turns it back on whenever it powers up.

operatingFlags.name: applicationRetries
operatingFlags.description: The device retries application messages as many times as its link database says, and reports cleanup errors.

operatingFlags.name: x10Off
operatingFlags.description: X10 sending and receiving are off.

operatingFlags.name: errorBlink
operatingFlags.description: The status LED blinks when a communication error occurs.

operatingFlags.name: cleanupReport
operatingFlags.description: The device sends a success report after the cleanup messages that follow a group command.

operatingFlags.name: checksumRequired
operatingFlags.description: Extended Set and link database write messages must carry a checksum in D14.

readings.name: databaseDelta
readings.description: A count that goes up whenever the link database changes.

readings.name: crcErrorCount
readings.description: The number of messages received with a CRC error.

verification.note: The Insteon Developer's Guide and the 2475SDB Developer Notes give query 0x02 as the signal-to-noise value of the last failure; the later command sheets count messages with CRC errors there.

flagCommands.name: smartHopsOn
flagCommands.description: Starts each message with the hop count of the last acknowledgment received (smart hops).

flagCommands.name: smartHopsOff
flagCommands.description: Starts each message with one hop.

flagCommands.name: yakityYakOff
flagCommands.description: Turns the Yakity Yak signaling option off.

flagCommands.name: yakityYakOn
flagCommands.description: Turns the Yakity Yak signaling option on.

flagCommands.name: modSyncFailureNoHop
flagCommands.description: When modulation sync fails, the device doesn't hop the message.

flagCommands.name: modSyncFailureOwnZeroCrossing
flagCommands.description: When modulation sync fails, the device uses its own zero crossing.

flagCommands.name: pushHopsToRadioOn
flagCommands.description: The device repeats every power line hop over RF.

flagCommands.name: pushHopsToRadioOff
flagCommands.description: The device doesn't repeat every power line hop over RF.

values.name: ledDimming
values.description: How far the LED is dimmed: 0x00 is no dimming, the brightest, 0x01 the most dimming and 0xFF the least.

values.name: x10HouseCode
values.description: The X10 house code, or 0x20 for no X10 address.

values.name: rampRate
values.description: The ramp rate, from 0x01 (8 minutes) to 0x1F (0.1 second). 0x00 is 2 seconds.

values.name: onLevel
values.description: The level the load turns on to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

writes.name: ledDimming
writes.description: Sets how far the LED is dimmed.

writes.name: ledBrightness
writes.description: Sets the brightness of the status LED, from 0x11 to 0x7F.

writes.name: x10AllMask
writes.description: Sets which buttons send X10 All On or All Off instead of On or Off, with button 1 in bit 0.

writes.name: nonToggleOnMask
writes.description: Sets which non-toggle buttons send On rather than Off, with button 1 in bit 0.

writes.name: triggerMask
writes.description: Sets which buttons are trigger buttons, with button 1 in bit 0.

standardCommands.name: lightOn
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to the level in cmd2 at the saved ramp rate.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOnFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to the level in cmd2 instantly.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: lightOff
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at the saved ramp rate. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: lightOffFast
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off instantly. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: brightenOneStep
standardCommands.description: Brightens the load one step of 32 from off to full. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: dimOneStep
standardCommands.description: Dims the load one step of 32 from off to full. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: startManualChange
standardCommands.description: Starts brightening or dimming the load until a stop manual change command.

parameter.name: direction
parameter.description: Which way to change the level.

standardCommands.name: stopManualChange
standardCommands.description: Stops a manual change. The device ignores cmd2.

standardCommands.name: readStatus
standardCommands.description: Reads the load's level. The acknowledgement's cmd1 carries the link database delta.

reply.name: onLevel
reply.description: The load's state: 0x00 for off or 0xFF for on.

standardCommands.name: instantChange
standardCommands.description: Sets the load to the level in cmd2 instantly.

parameter.name: onLevel
parameter.description: The level to go to, from 0x00 (off) to 0xFF (full).

standardCommands.name: remoteSetButtonTap
standardCommands.description: Acts as a tap of the device's set button.

verification.note: The Developer Notes give cmd2 of cmd1 0x25 as 0x00 to set the on-level and 0x02 to set the ramp rate; Insteon's 2007 command tables give it as the number of taps, 0x01 or 0x02.

standardCommands.name: onAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the load on to a level at a ramp rate, both given in cmd2.

parameter.name: levelAndRampRate
parameter.description: Bits 4 through 7 give the level, which is 16 times their value plus 0x0F, and bits 0 through 3 the ramp rate, which is 2 times their value plus 1.

standardCommands.name: offAtRampRate
standardCommands.description: Turns the load off at a ramp rate given in cmd2. Bits 4 through 7 are 0.

parameter.name: rampRate
parameter.description: The ramp rate, which is 2 times this value plus 1.

standardCommands.name: beep
standardCommands.description: Beeps once, as pressing the set button does. The device ignores cmd2.

extendedCommands.name: triggerGroup
extendedCommands.description: Sends group D1's command to the group as if its button were pressed, and sets the local load as D2 through D6 say. The device doesn't parse the command it sends, so to turn the local load off, put 0x01 in D2 and 0x00 in D3.

parameters.name: levelSource
parameters.description: Which level the local load goes to.

parameters.name: onLevel
parameters.description: The level the local load goes to when D2 is 0x01.

parameters.name: groupCommand1
parameters.description: The cmd1 to send to the group.

parameters.name: groupCommand2
parameters.description: The cmd2 to send to the group.

parameters.name: rampRate
parameters.description: How fast the local load changes.

notes: The 2475SDB Developer Notes call the product the 277V In-LineLinc Relay, and its examples show category 0x01 and subcategory 0x0E, which the catalog gives to the 2457D2.
The 2475SDB Developer Notes list no status request; Insteon's 2007 command tables give cmd1 0x19 for every on/off device.
